note: GD.28: gin's RouterGroup.Use returns the group itself, so `x := Router.Group("authority").Use(mw)` keeps the group's prefix (the gin-vue-admin shape: 61 of its 65 unpaired endpoints). Before GD.28 (2fc4daa9, debug CLI) a chained group carried no mount and registered at the root: POST /createAuthority, POST /addMenu, GET /getLogList, while the un-chained Router.Group("authority") minted POST /authority/getAuthorityList; [http] paired=1 of 4. Covers one Use link, two Use links, a chained group stored on a struct field another method registers on, and the plain group beside the chained one.
